name: saferoom
description: Environment, scope, and credential management for the FortMesa MCP proxy — across Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.

scripts.test:unit: yarn clean && yarn build && yarn node --test "dist/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs" "src/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test: yarn format:check && yarn lint && yarn test:unit
scripts.package:ext: yarn build && yarn build:ext && yarn build:cli && yarn build:mcpb && FORTMESA_PROD_ONLY=${FORTMESA_PROD_ONLY:-false} yarn verify:prod-strip && yarn notices:check && vsce package --no-dependencies --no-rewrite-relative-links -o "FortMesa-Saferoom-$npm_package_version.vsix"

fortmesa.activeEnv.description: The active FortMesa environment. Mirrors config.json's activeEnv; switching this setting re-targets the fortmesa MCP server for every IDE without touching their config files. Machine-scoped so Settings Sync cannot replicate it to another host and re-target a live proxy there -- credentials live in ~/.fmcode and do NOT sync, so a travelling environment produces a host whose selected environment and stored credentials disagree.

gateway.description: The MCP gateway URL for this environment.

fortmesa.environments.description: Per-environment gateway URL overrides (environment name -> { gateway }). Mirrors config.json's environments map.

enumDescriptions: Every scope this account is entitled to is accessible, including scopes granted later. No Saferoom control sets this any more — use Choose Accessible Scopes › Select all, or edit config.json.
fortmesa.scopeLock.mode.description: How the accessible-scope set is expressed. Mirrors config.json's scopeLock.mode.

fortmesa.scopeLock.scopes.description: The accessible scope names. Exactly one entry when scopeLock.mode is "single"; one or more when "multi"; ignored when "unlocked". Mirrors config.json's scopeLock.scopes.

fortmesa.ideSync.claude.description: Keep the fortmesa MCP server registration synced to Claude Code.

fortmesa.ideSync.vscode.description: Keep the fortmesa MCP server registration synced to VS Code (native vscode.lm API).

fortmesa.ideSync.cursor.description: Keep the fortmesa MCP server registration synced to Cursor.

fortmesa.ideSync.codex.description: Keep the fortmesa MCP server registration synced to Codex.

fortmesa.ideSync.antigravity.description: Keep the fortmesa MCP server registration synced to Antigravity.

fortmesa.ideSync.copilot.description: Project the fortmesa MCP server into GitHub Copilot (VS Code user-level mcp.json).

fortmesa.disabledTools.description: MCP tool names hidden from tools/list and rejected on direct call. Global (not per-environment). Mirrors config.json's disabledTools.

enumDescriptions: Local-file mode: the extension handles documents on this machine -- agents read and write files by path in your workspace, and the extension uploads and downloads through your signed-in session.
Network mode: the gateway's URL-based tools are exposed instead -- agents receive signed upload and download links and move the bytes themselves. No workspace file access.
fortmesa.documentsMode.description: Which implementation of the grc_documents_* tools is exposed to agents. Mirrors config.json's documentsMode.

fortmesa.logLevel.description: Log verbosity for the Saferoom extension and the local MCP proxy. Mirrors config.json's logLevel.

fortmesa-logo.description: FortMesa brand mark (full logo), reproduced faithfully from media/logo.svg as an icon-font glyph sized to codicon metrics.
